dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Sucrose! It's been a while since the last time we saw you!

dialogues.speaker: Sucrose
dialogues.text: On the way here, I overheard quite a few people talking about alchemical potions.

dialogues.speaker: Sucrose
dialogues.text: At first, I was worried something might have gone wrong with the herbs, but judging by the way people were talking, it seems like they were pretty pleased with the results!

dialogues.speaker: Lisa
dialogues.text: Hehe, Sucrose, your bio-alchemical expertise was exactly what we needed for potion making.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Yeah! We've been able to make potions with all sorts of different effects!

dialogues.speaker: Sucrose
dialogues.text: #You mastered potion-making in such a short amount of time? I guess that's expected for someone of your talent, {NICKNAME}.

dialogues.speaker: Lisa
dialogues.text: #I wouldn't be surprised if {M#he}{F#she} became a potion master one day.

choices.text: I've still got a long way to go...

response.speaker: Sucrose
response.text: #Still, if you managed to master potion-making in such a short amount of time, {NICKNAME}, we should be able to start teaching the public about it as well.

response.speaker: Lisa
response.text: Wait, was that also a part of Jean's plan?

response.speaker: Sucrose
response.text: Yep. It's something she and Mr. Albedo talked about... As I understand it, the goal was not just to create and sell potions, but also to teach the principles and practices of alchemy to the people.

response.speaker: Sucrose
response.text: Thanks to your shop, the public's understanding of alchemical potions has increased quite a bit. Perhaps, one day, they'll even be able to make simple potions themselves...

response.speaker: Lisa
response.text: Hmm, without the proper training, though, those potions could be dangerous to use...

response.speaker: Sucrose
response.text: #You're right... With Lisa there to mentor you, {NICKNAME}, we could rest assured that nothing would go wrong during the potion-making process. However, when it comes to the general public, we have to think of a way to ensure that any resulting potions would be safe to use.

response.speaker: Sucrose
response.text: So, Mr. Albedo is planning to establish a set of criteria to evaluate various levels of potion-making ability. People will have to pass the exam that corresponds to their level of proficiency before being allowed to brew their own potions.

response.speaker: Lisa
response.text: Let me guess... You would like us to also take part in this exam?

response.speaker: Sucrose
response.text: Yes, although it would probably be more accurate to say that... we would like you to help us finalize the contents of the exam.

response.speaker: Sucrose
response.text: #In order to ensure a proper level of difficulty, we need to first collect the relevant data. That's where our mock exam comes in. If you could take it, {NICKNAME}, your results would serve as a very important reference for us.

response.speaker: Sucrose
response.text: You will, of course, be compensated for your efforts!

response.speaker: Lisa
response.text: Hehe, what a great idea! I must admit, I'm very interested to see how much my cutie's alchemy skills have improved.

choices.text: I guess I could give it a go.

response.speaker: Sucrose
response.text: Wonderful. Then let me explain a little bit about how the exam works. The exam has four levels: Beginner, Intermediate, Advanced, and Expert.

response.speaker: Sucrose
response.text: To pass, all you need to do is brew a potion within the time limit that satisfies the main objective.

response.speaker: Sucrose
response.text: Satisfying additional objectives will earn you extra rewards.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Okay, all this is starting to sound pretty official. Paimon's nervous all of a sudden.

response.speaker: Sucrose
response.text: Just do what you normally do and you should be fine. If you don't pass the first time around, you can always retake the exam, so no need to put too much pressure on yourselves.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Oh, retakes are allowed! Phew, that's a relief!

response.speaker: Sucrose
response.text: Yep! Just let me know when you're ready.

choices.text: I still need a little more time...

response.speaker: Sucrose
response.text: No problem, I'll be waiting for you here.

response.speaker: Lisa
response.text: Hehe, confidence is a good look on you, cutie!
